user.title: Add a tablet
user.description: Give the tablet a name. A pairing token is generated on the next screen.

pair.title: Pair the HA Sidecar app
pair.description:
In the HA Sidecar app enter this Home Assistant URL and the token below, then press Submit here.

**Token:** `{token}`

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launches an app on the tablet.

path.name: Path
path.description: Optional HA frontend path; only used for the HA companion app (homeassistant://navigate/<path>).

set_allowlist.name: Set allowed apps
set_allowlist.description: Sets which apps may run during lockdown.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Creates or updates a native alarm on the tablet.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: Reuse to update an existing alarm.

install_system_update.name: Install system update
install_system_update.description: Device owner only: installs an A/B OTA package from a URI readable by the system.

bring_to_front.name: Bring dashboard to front
bring_to_front.description: Brings the HA companion app to the front without restarting it.

path.name: Path
path.description: Optional dashboard path to navigate to.

init.title: Display inputs
init.description: Entities that drive the tablet's brightness logic. Everything else is configured with the entities of the device.

data_description.presence_entities: Any of these being on means someone is near the tablet (mmWave, PIR, ...). Optional: the tablet can also use its camera.
data_description.night_entity: On = night. A sun entity counts as night while below the horizon. Leave empty to use the night schedule on the tablet.
